test_split_coupling_properties: test the SplitCoupling bijector properties including split_index, split_axis, swap, conditioner, and bijector attributes
test_split_coupling_invalid_properties: test that SplitCoupling raises ValueError on negative split_index, negative event_ndims, or invalid split_axis
test_split_coupling_shapes: test that SplitCoupling forward_and_log_det and inverse_and_log_det preserve input tensor shapes across parameter combinations
test_split_coupling_inverse_correctness: test that SplitCoupling inverse_and_log_det recovers original input and negates the forward log determinant
test_split_coupling_jittable: test that SplitCoupling forward is compatible with JAX JIT compilation
